title: Napoli lose Meret to back fracture ahead of Torino clash
snippet: Napoli’s injury crisis has worsened, with goalkeeper Alex Meret suffering a fracture to his fifth...
body: NAPLES, ITALY - SEPTEMBER 09: Alex Meret of SSC Napoli during the UEFA Champions League 2026/27 League Phase MD1 match between SSC Napoli and Arsenal FC at Stadio Diego Armando Maradona on September 09, 2026 in Naples, Italy. (Photo by Maurizio Lagana/Getty Images) Napoli’s injury crisis has worsened, with goalkeeper Alex Meret suffering a fracture to his fifth lumbar vertebra in training. According to an official club statement, via TMW , Meret was hurt during a training session and underwent tests at Pineta Grande Hospital, which confirmed the fracture. He has already started his rehabilitation, but the club didn’t give a timescale for his return. It’s another setback for Massimiliano Allegri, who already has a long list of absentees. Giovanni Di Lorenzo, Leonardo Spinazzola, Stanislav Lobotka, Benoit Badiashile, David Neres and Alessandro Buongiorno were all missing for the 1-1 draw with Lazio before the international break . Vanja Milinković-Savić started in goal that day and impressed, with several important saves to keep Napoli in the game. The Serbian now looks set to stay in the side. There was some better news for the Partenopei, as all their internationals have returned to Castel Volturno. Allegri’s squad trained on Thursday afternoon ahead of Saturday’s game against Torino at the Stadio Diego Armando Maradona, which kicks off at 20:45 CET [19:45 GMT]. Napoli are 10th on 15 points, 14 behind leaders Lazio, and Allegri is under growing pressure to turn things around.
summary_en: Napoli goalkeeper Alex Meret fractured a lumbar vertebra in training, with no return date given.

title: OGC Nice’s Mohamed Abdelmonem ruled out of PSG clash
snippet: OGC Nice will be without centre-back Mohamed Abdelmonem for Saturday night’s match against Paris Saint-Germain, Olivier Pantaloni confirmed in a press conference attended by Get French Football News. Abdelmonem, who…
body: OGC Nice will be without centre-back Mohamed Abdelmonem for Saturday night’s match against Paris Saint-Germain, Olivier Pantaloni confirmed in a press conference attended by Get French Football News. Abdelmonem, who didn’t participate in Egypt’s games over the course of the most international break, is absent with a hamstring injury. Earlier on Thursday, in a training session attended by Get French Football News, the centre-back was absent, although as has become standard under Pantaloni, so were many first-teamers two days before the game. A lighter session on ‘J-2’ is part of Pantaloni’s scheduling. Abdelmonem could then be seen undergoing an individual session. Pantaloni may instead rely on Alidu Seidu, who, like Abdelmonem, had a lighter session, completing a couple of laps around the pitch alongside Xavier Mandza. There are also players that are still trickling back through the door after the international break. Pantaloni said, however, that there are no further injury concerns ahead of the game against PSG at the Allianz Riviera. GFFN | Luke Entwistle – reporting from Nice
summary_en: Nice defender Mohamed Abdelmonem will miss the PSG match due to a hamstring problem.
